name: Missouri
summary: Red, white and blue horizontal bands with the state coat of arms in the centre, encircled by a blue band of 24 white stars. Missouri was the 24th state.
origin: Marie Elizabeth Watkins Oliver, wife of a state senator, designed the flag around 1908. It was adopted on 22 March 1913.

symbols.name: Coat of arms
symbols.description: Two grizzly bears supporting a shield with the US arms and a crescent and bear, on a scroll reading 'Salus populi suprema lex esto' and 'MDCCCXX'.
symbols.meaning: The state's strength and its place in the Union; the motto means 'Let the welfare of the people be the supreme law'.

symbols.name: Twenty-four stars
symbols.description: A ring of white stars on blue.

facts: The Roman numerals MDCCCXX (1820) mark the Missouri Compromise.
The bears are grizzlies, a symbol of strength and bravery.
Its red-white-blue layout resembles the Dutch flag.
clues: Red, white and blue bands with a coat of arms with two bears in a ring of 24 stars.
Its stars show it was the 24th state.
Its arms show the Roman numerals for 1820.
